_comment: How sales say product names. Edit through a pull request. See docs/product-selection.md. What is typed is lower-cased, and 'year old', 'yo', 'single malt' and similar filler are dropped before any of this applies.

abbreviations._comment: A short code that means one thing. Typed 'GA 10 CS' is read as 'glenallachie 10 cask strength'.

groups._comment: A short code that means ANY ONE of several names. Typed 'DD arran 10' finds an Arran 10 from any of these bottlers.

aliases._comment: For a product whose usual short name is not what its title reduces to. `say` is what people type. `title_has` says which product it means, by words in its title, so no product id is needed and a new batch just works. The product must be in the Popular Trade Products collection.
aliases.name: Arran Sherry
